verdict.rationale: Secureframe's REST API returns standard JSON (JSON API spec) and can reach any existing object in the account. Its MCP server also exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks. Together these give a programmatic route to pull data out in an open format, but this is DIY extraction rather than a documented export path (the CSV evidence covers import only). Missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account export feature, export of policies/evidence files in open formats, any offboarding or data-portability policy, and hands-on confirmation that a complete extraction is possible.
